items.question: Which qualified person should cause the construction work to be performed when the ācārya is mantra-worthy?
premises: defective lines harm patron and artisan
items.inference: mantra-worthiness of the ācārya does not make him the builder; the sthapati executes the work
uncertainties: tu may mark contrast or exception
karma may mean ritual work or construction work
items.plain_english: The ācārya is mantra-worthy, but the master-builder should cause the work to be done.
